text: The Applicant for 169 Beechwood Avenue has requested North York Community Council to exempt their property from the following bylaw requirements: City of Toronto Municipal Code Chapter 447 - 1.3 Swimming pool enclosures. - Section C. Access Protection (3) - Section C. Access Protection (6)(c)(1) - Section E. Construction standards (1)(b) - Section E. Construction standards (2) (c) [1] The Applicant for 169 Beechwood Avenue is requesting an exemption for their existing fence as constructed. - The swimming pool enclosure constructed with vertical metal pickets has spaces more than 38 millimetres apart (137 millimetres and 86 millimetres measured) where horizontal rails are spaced less than 1.2 meters apart. (Section E. (2) (c) [1]) - The swimming pool enclosure is less than 1.8 meters high and is closer than 1 meter to an external condition (exterior wall plug with safety dome cover, and…

North York Community Council: 1. Refused to grant an exemption to Chapter 447, Fences, to the property owner of 169 Beechwood Avenue, for the existing fence described in the Summary of the report (May 27, 2026) District Manager, Municipal Licensing and Standards, Central District.
